A bag contains 10 red balls and 8 green balls. Anna takes two balls at random without replacement. She claims P(one red and one green) = 2/9.

Explain why she is wrong and find the correct probability.

A bag has 10 red and 8 green balls. n red balls are removed. Two balls are then drawn without replacement. P(both green) = 4/13.

Show that n^2 - 35n + 124 = 0.
questions.explanation:
P(both green) = [8/(18-n)] x [7/(17-n)] = 4/13.
Cross-multiply and expand to get n^2 - 35n + 124 = 0.

questions.prompt: When solving n^2 - 35n + 124 = 0 for the number of red balls removed from a bag that originally had only 10 red balls, explain why one solution must be rejected.
questions.model_answer: n = 31 is impossible because there are only 10 red balls.
questions.explanation: n=31 would remove more red balls than exist; accept n=4 only.

A(-1, 3), B(7, 9). Point X lies on AB such that area(triangle AXD) : area(triangle BXD) = 1 : 3.

Find AX.
questions.explanation:
Equal heights from D to AB, so AX : XB = 1 : 3.
AX = 1/4 x AB = 1/4 x 10 = 2.5 units.

questions.explanation: Rows are drink types; columns are Belinda and Carol.

questions.prompt:

State what each element of R represents.
questions.model_answer: Each element is the total cost of the drinks ordered by Belinda or Carol at that cafe.
questions.explanation: Each entry is total bill for that person at that cafe.

questions.prompt:
Belinda and Carol each buy from the cheaper cafe in February (Belinda: 2A, 4L, 3M; Carol: 5L, 4M). In July they buy the same from the same cafes. Prices change: Americano +10%, Latte +15%, Mocha -5% (both cafes).

Calculate the percentage change in the combined total spent (February + July vs February alone doubled).
questions.explanation: Feb total $120.30; July total ≈ $127.53. % change on 2×Feb ≈ 6.01%.

questions.prompt:
40 students: time on social media (hours) — <10: p, 10-20: 11, 20-30: 10, 30-40: q, 40-50: 3. Upper quartile = 30 hours.

Show that p = 9 and find q.
questions.explanation:
75% of 40 = 30 students at most 30 hours.
p + 11 + 10 = 30, so p = 9.
q = 40 - 30 - 3 = 7.

For the grouped data with frequencies 9, 11, 10, 7, 3 and midpoints 5, 15, 25, 35, 45, estimate the standard deviation.
questions.explanation: Use calculator statistics on grouped data: SD ≈ 12.2 hours (3 s.f.).
